title: Authorization code not bound to redirect_uri
description: api.rs:660,740-743. When creating the authz code (line 660), the redirect_uri from the form is stored. In the token exchange (line 740-743), redirect_uri validation only happens if the client provides one in the request — it's optional. Per RFC 6749 Section 4.1.3, if the redirect_uri was included in the authorization request, it MUST be included in the token request and the values MUST be identical. The current code allows omitting redirect_uri in the token request, which could enable a redirect_uri confusion attack if multiple redirect URIs were allowed per app.
